thread:
maya: heads up — starting ~10:12 we started seeing SAML JIT failures for contractor logins after the Okta attribute enforcement change. some folks are hitting role mapping fallback.

alex: saw same. auth-service returning 500s, logs show KMS decrypt errors then assertion missing 'roles' claim.

infra-bot: deploy: auth-service v2.14.0 -> prod at 2026-03-18T10:11:09Z :package: 

jamal: pasting relevant log snippet:```
ERROR auth.saml: decrypt failure, key=alias/redwood/saml-keys, err=InvalidCiphertextException: "RSA padding check failed"
WARN auth.saml: assertion parsed but missing attribute 'roles' -> applying fallback role precedence
```

sec-ops: quick summary: Okta app updated attribute requirements (employmentStatus required). Some SAML assertions are now encrypted with a rotated key; our KMS access path returned decrypt errors for a subset of pods during deploy window. Missing roles then triggered fallback; due to a mapping order bug contractors got elevated to 'org-admin' in one mapping path.

maya: reproduction steps I used: 1) POST SAML response to /sso/callback (with assertion missing roles claim) 2) see fallbackUsed=true in response JSON 3) event logged as INFO not AUDIT. Example: `curl -XPOST https://auth.redwood.local/sso/callback -d @saml_missing_roles.xml`

alex: confirmed: the code path that chooses fallback previously prioritized `legacy_default_role` before `least_privilege_default`. bug in refactor. simple fix: reorder precedence, add explicit audit event when any fallback is used.

jamal: creating hotfix PR with two changes: 1) reorder fallback precedence 2) emit audit.v1 event with fields: user_id, assertion_id, fallback_reason, kms_key_id. also adding integration test that simulates KMS InvalidCiphertextException.

sre-oncall: set severity P2 for access-impacting mapping bug. Created incident INC-2026-0318-7 and assigned oncall. Please post timeline in ticket. :rotating_light:

okta-bot: config-change detected by Okta at 2026-03-18T10:09:33Z — Application attribute enforcement set: employmentStatus=required. Change author: @it-admin.

sec-ops: followups we need: (a) add monitor metric `saml.fallback.count` -> alert if >5 in 5m; (b) update KMS rotation runbook to include staged pod rollout and agent-level key caching; (c) surface fallback events to audit-pipeline (kafka-topic: audit.events).

maya: PR link: https://git.redwood/s/auth-service/pulls/842 (hotfix). will canary 5% on Dedicated then 100% after 30m if no new fallbacks.

infra-bot: canary rollout started: auth-service v2.14.1-canary (5%) at 2026-03-18T11:02:00Z

alex: after canary we saw fallback count drop to 0 in canary region. rolling to remaining hosts now.

jamal: added unit + integration tests, and a new audit schema entry. Note: audit entries must not include raw SAML assertion (PII). storing assertion_id and hashed_subject.

sec-ops: postmortem items: 1) prevent attribute-enforcement changes in Okta from shipping without a change request to sec team, 2) verify KMS rotation steps against live pod fleet, 3) add a regression test for fallback precedence to CI.

maya: closing loop: patched, rolled, and incident ticket updated. will follow up with retro doc later. thanks all :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: closing INC-2026-0318-7 after validation at 2026-03-18T14:00Z.

okta-bot: note: IT has scheduled a controlled attribute-enforcement rollout for next week and will notify sec@redwood before changes.
